review_scope: Corrected causal online relationship feature and normalizer core only

methods.detail: 23 tests passed in 7.10 seconds; the run used PYTHONPATH pointed at the actor worktree src and a one-CPU, 800 MB bounded scope. An earlier run without that path imported the root editable package and is excluded from this result.

Compared fitted FP32 means/scales and independently indexed scalar stream features for both lags and arms A/B/C on separate synthetic fitting and evaluation sequences. All six streams and all four normalizer vectors matched within rtol 2e-5, atol 3e-6.

Confirmed canonical I0 channels 0:52 and I1 channels 52:104, horizon-16 maturation at zero-based row 16, lag ring alignment, sequence reset, pre-update error, post-update forecast, and B updates only at rows 16 through 98 inclusive.

confirmed_behavior.unavailable_u: zero placeholder after standardization; placeholder matured pairs are retained in the online update stream
confirmed_behavior.normalizer: fit-only raw u and v differences, separate centered FP32 moments, standard-deviation floor 0.001; standardized differences clipped to +/-8 before the online state update
confirmed_behavior.checkpoint_binding: state dictionary serializes exact normalizer content and rejects restore under different normalizer values

nonblocking.finding: load_state_dict accepts bool for the rows field because bool is an int subclass in Python.
nonblocking.evidence: The current validation checks isinstance(rows, int) and rows >= 0.
nonblocking.consequence: A malformed external state with rows=true can be restored as row count 1; internally produced checkpoints use ordinary integers.
nonblocking.suggested_resolution: Also reject isinstance(rows, bool) if serialized state may be externally supplied. This does not block the reviewed experiment core.

limitations: This receipt reviews the corrected feature/normalizer core and synthetic invariants, not trainer or data-loader integration, fit membership, output provenance, candidate prediction caches, or any fitted endpoint.
No candidate or parent outputs were graded, and no fit or quality claim follows from these checks.
Evaluation folds remain exposed; any later paired component bootstrap is conditional on fixed endpoints and does not identify seed and fold effects separately.
decision: Core source review passes with no blocking finding; continue only under root-owned resource admission and artifact preflight.
